english.title: Use building constructed over highway otherwise than in accordance with licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a building

(A)_[constructed over part of **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), a highway maintainable at the public expense,]_
(B)_[constructed over part of **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), a highway maintainable at the public expense, and which had been altered]_

in pursuance of a licence granted under section 177 of the Highways Act 1980, otherwise than in accordance with the terms and conditions, namely **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT TERM OR CONDITION..), of that licence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 177(1)(b) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
used a building constructed over highway
which had been constructed or altered in pursuance of section 177 licence
otherwise than in accordance with the terms and conditions of that licence

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant used a building

(A)_[constructed over part of **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), a highway maintainable at the public expense,]_
(B)_[constructed over part of **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), a highway maintainable at the public expense, and which had been altered]_

in pursuance of a licence granted under section 177 of the Highways Act 1980, otherwise than in accordance with the terms and conditions, namely **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT TERM OR CONDITION..), of that licence.

other.penalty:
A fine, if the offence is continued after conviction, he is guilty of a further offence and liable to a fine not exceeding £50 for each day on which the offence is so continued.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

libra.complexpenaltydetails: A fine and, if the offence is continued after conviction, he is guilty of a further offence and liable to a fine not exceeding £50 for each day on which the offence is so continued.
